title: PenguinMod SMP Modpack
description: The OFFICIAL modpack for the UNOFFICIAL PenguinMod SMP!
body:
**The PMSMP has since been disbanded / shutdown from inactivity and lack of a server for hosting. This pack is no longer updated unless it's developers decide to continue the SMP.**
# The PenguinMod (unofficial) SMP

This is an _UNOFFICIAL_ Survival Multiplayer server ran by moderators of the website penguinmod.com! 

We're not official, but we do have alot of people from PM in our server.
In this modpack, you will find all the mods needed to join the PMSMP.
It is updated frequently and is the recommended way to get the mods for our server.

We hope you enjoy!

-The PMSMP Team
